Introduction. Guck are resources dropped by Abominations and Gucksacks in Swamps.
They can be used to refuel Standing green-burning iron torches.

Notes. • Gucksacks are not damaged by ranged attacks and must be mined with an axe or pickaxe. Players must build elevated platforms or ladders to reach the Gucksacks.
